tools.name: search_talent
tools.description: Find people on Youth4work who hold a skill, ranked by their assessed talent score, optionally in one Indian city. Returns public profile cards (name, headline, city, college, course, score, profile url); never contact details. Private and deactivated profiles are excluded.

skill.description: One skill or talent, e.g. "Python", "Digital Marketing", "Aptitude"

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Public profile of one Youth4work member by username (the part after /y/ in https://www.youth4work.com/y/{username}): a short factual summary (the same "About" text the profile page shows), skill test ranks (rank N of M, top X%), headline, about, city, education, top assessed talents with scores, work experience and the canonical profile url. No contact details.

tools.name: list_talent_categories
tools.description: Talent categories on Youth4work (e.g. Software and Programming, Finance, Sales and Marketing) with their most popular skills. Use the skill names with search_talent.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Live job and internship openings on Youth4work (www.cos.youth4work.com), newest first, including government jobs (sarkari naukri: PSUs, banks, institutes; flagged government=true). Matches the keyword against job title, summary and required skills. Returns title, company, city, type, experience, salary (lakhs per year), government and the job url where the user can apply.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one live job by id (from search_jobs): description, skills, courses, salary, experience, company page and the apply url. Government jobs (government=true) carry the notice details such as eligibility and last date; the person applies on the job page. Recruiter contact details are not shared.

tools.name: search_mock_tests
tools.description: Exam preparation on Youth4work Prep (start free: a free account gets 50 practice questions per exam category and a free sample mock test where available; a paid pack unlocks every test, see the result note): finds exams (e.g. "SSC CGL", "IBPS PO", "RRB NTPC", "CAT") by name and/or category (e.g. "Government Jobs", "Bank", "Placement Papers"), most popular first, each with its exam page url and up to 5 mock tests (questions, minutes, url).

exam.description: Exam name or part of it, e.g. "SSC", "IBPS PO"

tools.name: get_mock_test
tools.description: Details of one mock test by id (from search_mock_tests): exam, sections, number of questions, duration, marking, the instructions page url and the url that starts the test (needs a free Youth4work sign-in; the note says what is free and what needs a Prep pack).

tools.name: search_colleges
tools.description: Indian colleges and universities on Youth4work University. Give at least one of: name (part of the college name), course (e.g. "B.Tech", "MBA", "B.Com") and city (e.g. "Pune"). Most active on Youth4work first. Returns name, university, city, state, website and profile url.

tools.name: get_college
tools.description: Public profile of one college by id (from search_colleges): university, city, address, website, about, highlights, courses offered with fees where known, student and faculty counts, profile url.
